sentences.en: Some were injured and others were killed in the accident.
sentences.zh: 一些人在事故中受伤了，还有一些人丧生。

sentences.en: He was injured in his left leg in the accident.
sentences.zh: 他在事故中左腿受了伤。

sentences.en: The doctor saved the four people injured in the accident.
sentences.zh: 医生救下了事故中的四名伤者。

senses.zh: 受伤的,受损害的,损伤感情的v.损害(injure的过去式),伤害（名誉、自尊等）,（尤指在事故中）伤害,使受伤
